name: PHYSICAL_CONTINUUM_CERTIFICATE_ADAPTER

basis.source: Bruno, Colafranceschi, Mele, Rovelli, Structure of the continuum limit of spin foams, Phys. Rev. D 114, 066005 (2026)

interpretation: This adapter prevents an over-strong continuum requirement from falsely excluding non-topological gravity. It does not weaken family-level physical-observable, transport, comparator or uncertainty obligations and does not modify RQIR Core v1.0.
